name: Valder Conservation Grant
summary: Small annual grants from Forest & Bird for individuals or groups running conservation projects in the Waikato region, such as pest control, monitoring and fencing. Can pay for equipment, travel and consumables.
reporting: Successful applicants present their results to the Waikato Branch when the research or project is completed.
